description: For appliance installation, this inspection checklist records connection requirements, code-listed parts, protection, leveling, anchoring, testing, haul-away, and customer orientation. Its supporting evidence includes delivery condition, fit measurements, connection photos, leak or electrical test, serial record, and operation check.

blocks.guidance: Link this appliance installation review to the service record.
blocks.label: Appliance Installation Review Reference

blocks.guidance: Confirm the reviewed appliance installation location and assets.
blocks.label: Appliance Installation Context

sections.guidance: Identify the appliance installation service, reviewed areas, crew, and customer.
sections.title: Service Visit Reference

blocks.guidance: Mark each appliance installation item after direct review.
items: Model, serial, location, dimensions, level, and anchoring are confirmed
Water, drain, gas, vent, or electrical connections are checked
Leak, polarity, clearance, and functional tests are recorded as applicable
Packaging damage and surrounding property condition are documented
Manuals, removed parts, warranty details, and haul-away are reconciled
Customer operation, shutoff, care, and support instructions are reviewed
blocks.label: Appliance Installation Task and Area Checks

blocks.guidance: Use one appliance installation row for each reviewed area.
blocks.label: Appliance Installation Area and Task Results

blocks.guidance: Do not connect incompatible, damaged, improperly supplied, poorly vented, leaking, or code-deficient installations. Route unresolved appliance installation work for review.
blocks.label: Appliance Installation Applicable Review Boundary

sections.guidance: Check completed appliance installation work by task, room, zone, or equipment.

subtitle: Appliance Installation Inspection Checklist: residential appliance delivery and installation using appliance model, connection requirements, and delivery condition.
title: Appliance Installation Inspection Checklist
use_case: Use the inspection checklist during residential appliance delivery and installation when the appliance installation record must identify appliance model, serial, location, dimensions, path, utilities, cabinetry, ventilation, and old-unit disposition. Complete the applicable handoff for installed condition, function verification, customer demonstration, warranty registration, debris removal, and signoff.
